::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(janitor)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(stargazer)
library(tidyverse)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
deaths <- read_csv("time_series_covid19_deaths_US.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
deaths_long <- deaths |> 
  filter(Province_State == "North Carolina") |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches(r"(\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2})"),
    names_to = "date",
    values_to = "deaths"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    date = as_date(date, format = "%m/%d/%y"),
    FIPS = as.character(FIPS)
  ) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  rename(
    county = admin2,
    state = province_state
  ) |> 
  select(fips, county, state, population, date, deaths) |> 
  mutate(deaths_per_thousand = deaths / population * 1000)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_csv(deaths_long, file = "covid19_deaths_long.csv")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
income <- read_excel("UnemploymentReport.xlsx", skip = 2) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  select(fips, name, median_household_income_2021) |> 
  rename(median_income = median_household_income_2021) |> 
  filter(name != "North Carolina")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_csv(income, file = "cleaned_income.csv")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
health_data <- read_excel("county_health_data_2021.xlsx", skip = 1)
names(health_data)[1:7] <- c(
  "indicator_category",
  "indicator_name",
  "indicator_descriptor",
  "source_label",
  "source_link",
  "blank",
  "nc"
)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
elderly_pop <- health_data |> 
  filter(indicator_name == "Elderly Population") |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(1:7),
    names_to = "county",
    values_to = "elderly_pop"
  ) |> 
  select(county, elderly_pop) |> 
  filter(!(county %in% c("Data year", "Data Notes"))) |> 
  mutate(elderly_pop = as.numeric(elderly_pop))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_csv(elderly_pop, file = "elderly_pop.csv")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
physicians <- health_data |> 
  filter(indicator_name == "Health Care Workforce - Primary Care Physicians") |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(1:7),
    names_to = "county",
    values_to = "physicians"
  ) |> 
  select(county, physicians) |> 
  filter(!(county %in% c("Data year", "Data Notes"))) |> 
  mutate(physicians = as.numeric(physicians))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_csv(physicians, file = "physicians.csv")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
smokers <- health_data |> 
  filter(indicator_name == "Adult Smoking") |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(1:7),
    names_to = "county",
    values_to = "smokers"
  ) |> 
  select(county, smokers) |> 
  filter(!(county %in% c("Data year", "Data Notes"))) |> 
  mutate(smokers = as.numeric(smokers))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_csv(smokers, file = "smokers.csv")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
health_covariates <- elderly_pop |> 
  inner_join(physicians) |> 
  inner_join(smokers)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
write_csv(health_covariates, file = "health_covariates.csv")
```
